_readme: Tin Kettle Kitchen: the made-up cafe on /examples/tin-kettle/. Every word on its pages lives here.
The ordering tool (/examples/tools/ordering/) reads the same name, hours, grill times, menu and extras, so change them here and both update when you run node build.js.
Photos: leave "photo" blank for a styled placeholder, or set it to a .webp in src/img/examples/tin-kettle/ (see README.md).

about.heading: A family kitchen
text: Tin Kettle is run by Nandi and her family. It started as a coffee counter with one old tin kettle, and grew into the café and grill it is today.
Almost everything on the menu is made in the kitchen at the back, the same way every day.
about.alt: Nandi in the Tin Kettle kitchen

hero.alt: The Tin Kettle counter with fresh breakfast rolls

items.name: Thandi
items.text: Lovely spot for breakfast. The kettle roll is the best in town, and the coffee is always hot. Friendly staff too.

items.name: Pieter
items.text: Went for the Friday grill with the family. Good rump, decent portions, and the kids loved the lemonade.

items.name: Ayesha
items.text: Quick, friendly and good value. The garden bowl is a winner. It gets busy on Saturdays, so go early.
